# Olivos Restaurant

> Mediterranean Restaurant in Tampa, Florida. Tapas, grilled lobster, seafood paella and steaks off the brasa, served warm in a room with paintings on the walls.

- Phone: (813) 252-4520
- Address: 7503 W Waters Ave, Tampa, FL 33615
- Areas: Tampa, Temple Terrace, Carrollwood, Town 'n' Country
- Offers: Tapas; From the sea; From the grill
- Rating: 4.8 from 2295 Google reviews
